 176: def check_layered_gate_guards(paths: LoopPaths,
 177:                               policy: OrchestrationPolicy) -> GateGuardReport:
 178:     """Evaluate ALL six layered-mode gate guards.
 179: 
 180:     Every guard is a disk/config observation 鈥?zero-model, reproducible.
 181:     Failing ANY guard blocks the mode flip (fail-closed) and the report names
 182:     exactly which guard failed (fail-visible).
 183:     """
 184:     now = utc_now()
 185:     results: dict[str, bool] = {}
 186:     details: dict[str, str] = {}
 187: 
 188:     # 1. consumer heartbeat exists and is fresh (搂2.2 heartbeat file).
 189:     hb_max_age = float(policy.value("routing", "l2_heartbeat_max_age_s", 300))
 190:     hb = read_json(paths.l2_heartbeat, None)
 191:     try:
 192:         hb_age = now - float(hb["ts"]) if isinstance(hb, dict) else None
 193:     except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
 194:         hb_age = None
 195:     ok = hb_age is not None and hb_age <= hb_max_age
 196:     results[GateGuard.CONSUMER_HEARTBEAT_FRESH.value] = ok
 197:     details[GateGuard.CONSUMER_HEARTBEAT_FRESH.value] = (
 198:         f"age={hb_age:.1f}s (max {hb_max_age}s)" if hb_age is not None
 199:         else f"heartbeat missing: {paths.l2_heartbeat}")
 200: 
 201:     # 2. exactly-once canary passed (stamp written by the canary test run:
 202:     #    N send_l2 records drained twice => exactly N claims).
 203:     canary = read_json(paths.l2_queue_dir / "exactly_once_canary.json", None)
 204:     ok = isinstance(canary, dict) and canary.get("status") == "PASS"
 205:     results[GateGuard.EXACTLY_ONCE_CANARY.value] = ok
 206:     details[GateGuard.EXACTLY_ONCE_CANARY.value] = (
 207:         f"status={canary.get('status')!r}" if isinstance(canary, dict)
 208:         else "canary stamp missing")
 209: 
 210:     # 3. K3 verifier model is pinned in policy AND agrees with the role TOML.
 211:     try:
 212:         pin = policy.model_pin("k3")
 213:         toml_model = _verifier_toml_model(paths)
 214:         ok = toml_model is None or toml_model == pin
 215:         results[GateGuard.K3_VERIFIER_MODEL_PINNED.value] = ok
 216:         details[GateGuard.K3_VERIFIER_MODEL_PINNED.value] = (
 217:             f"policy pin={pin!r}, verifier.toml={toml_model!r}")
 218:     except ModelPinError as exc:
 219:         results[GateGuard.K3_VERIFIER_MODEL_PINNED.value] = False
 220:         details[GateGuard.K3_VERIFIER_MODEL_PINNED.value] = str(exc)
 221: 
 222:     # 4. short-result validator is enabled (publish-point enforcement flag).
 223:     srv = read_json(paths.data / "validators" / "short_result_validator.json", None)
 224:     ok = isinstance(srv, dict) and bool(srv.get("enabled"))
 225:     results[GateGuard.SHORT_RESULT_VALIDATOR_ENABLED.value] = ok
 226:     details[GateGuard.SHORT_RESULT_VALIDATOR_ENABLED.value] = (
 227:         f"enabled={srv.get('enabled')}" if isinstance(srv, dict)
 228:         else "validator marker missing")
 229: 
 230:     # 5. state-machine schema is compatible (t27鈥搕38 must exist on-table).
 231:     required = str(policy.value("routing", "statemachine_schema_required",
 232:                                 "codex-loop-statemachine/v2"))
 233:     ledger = read_json(paths.ledger, {}) or {}
 234:     schema = ledger.get("schema")
 235:     ok = schema == required
 236:     if not ok:
 237:         # A fresh ledger has no schema yet 鈥?accept when the v2 module is
 238:         # importable and validates (the table itself is the compatibility).
 239:         try:
 240:             import statemachine_v2  # noqa: F401  (same directory)
 241:             ok = statemachine_v2.SCHEMA == required
 242:             schema = statemachine_v2.SCHEMA
 243:         except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - import environment specific
 244:             ok = False
 245:     results[GateGuard.STATEMACHINE_SCHEMA_COMPATIBLE.value] = ok
 246:     details[GateGuard.STATEMACHINE_SCHEMA_COMPATIBLE.value] = (
 247:         f"required={required!r}, found={schema!r}")
 248: 
 249:     # 6. rollback key is available (single-key revert to cold_start).
 250:     rollback = policy.value("routing", "rollback_key")
 251:     ok = isinstance(rollback, str) and bool(rollback)
 252:     results[GateGuard.ROLLBACK_KEY_AVAILABLE.value] = ok
 253:     details[GateGuard.ROLLBACK_KEY_AVAILABLE.value] = f"rollback_key={rollback!r}"
 254: 
 255:     return GateGuardReport(passed=all(results.values()),
 256:                            results=results, details=details)

 275: class ConfidenceCalibrator:
 276:     """Calibrated escalation confidence from mechanical signals.
 277: 
 278:     Never consumes self-reported model confidence.  The calibrator maintains
 279:     per-fingerprint outcome counts (``data/router/calibration.json``): a
 280:     fingerprint is the sorted tuple of trigger rules hit plus coarse signal
 281:     buckets.  ``p_escalate(fingerprint)`` is the Laplace-smoothed frequency
 282:     with which packets carrying that fingerprint historically required L3+
 283:     escalation.  With no history the calibrator returns the conservative
 284:     prior (escalate), which preserves cold-start safety.
 285:     """
 286: 
 287:     #: Laplace smoothing pseudo-counts (conservative prior: escalate).
 288:     PRIOR_ESCALATE: Final[float] = 1.0
 289:     PRIOR_TOTAL: Final[float] = 2.0
 290: 
 291:     def __init__(self, paths: LoopPaths) -> None:
 292:         self.paths = paths
 293:         self.path = paths.router_dir / "calibration.json"
 294:         self._lock = threading.Lock()
 295: 
 296:     @staticmethod
 297:     def fingerprint(signals: Mapping[str, Any], rules_hit: list[str]) -> str:
 298:         """Deterministic feature fingerprint from mechanical signals only."""
 299:         exit_codes = signals.get("exit_codes") or []
 300:         buckets = (
 301:             "rc0" if exit_codes == [0] else
 302:             "rcmix" if any(c == 0 for c in exit_codes) else "rcfail",
 303:             f"retry{min(int(signals.get('retry_count', 0) or 0), 3)}",
 304:             "diff0" if not signals.get("diff_lines") else "diff+",
 305:         )
 306:         return "|".join(sorted(set(rules_hit)) + list(buckets))
 307: 
 308:     def p_escalate(self, fingerprint: str) -> float:
 309:         """Calibrated probability that this fingerprint needs L3+ review."""
 310:         doc = read_json(self.path, {}) or {}
 311:         entry = doc.get(fingerprint, {})
 312:         escalated = float(entry.get("escalated", 0)) + self.PRIOR_ESCALATE
 313:         total = float(entry.get("total", 0)) + self.PRIOR_TOTAL
 314:         return escalated / total
 315: 
 316:     def record_outcome(self, fingerprint: str, escalated: bool) -> None:
 317:         """Feed a downstream outcome back into the calibration corpus."""
 318:         with self._lock:
 319:             doc = read_json(self.path, {}) or {}
 320:             entry = doc.setdefault(fingerprint, {"escalated": 0, "total": 0})

   4: # Purpose : append one single-line JSON record per subagent spawn to
   5: #           data/events.ndjson (fail-visible routing health observation;
   6: #           the 25x price differential between tiers makes `model` a
   7: #           non-forgeable routing signal)
   8: # Input   : SubagentStart hook payload as one JSON object on stdin
   9: #           (fields used: model, cwd, agent_type, agent_id, turn_id,
  10: #            session_id, permission_mode)
  11: # Output  : one NDJSON line appended to $LOOP_DATA_DIR/events.ndjson
  12: #           {"event":"SubagentStart","ts_utc":...,"model":...,"cwd":...,
  13: #            "agent_role":...,"agent_id":...,"turn_id":...,"session_id":...,
  14: #            "permission_mode":...}
  15: # Safety  : FAIL-OPEN â€?this hook is pure observation (spec Â§10 S4). It must
  16: #           NEVER block a spawn: every failure path exits 0. SubagentStart
  17: #           cannot block spawns at the platform level either; events.ndjson
  18: #           is only the fast path â€?report files are the second truth source.
  19: # Lines   : ~55
  20: # ============================================================================
  21: 
  22: # Everything is wrapped so that any error still results in exit 0.
  23: {
  24:   # Data directory: repo-local data/ by default, overridable for tests.
  25:   DATA_DIR="${LOOP_DATA_DIR:-data}"
  26:   OUT_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/events.ndjson"
  27: 
  28:   # Read the entire stdin payload (single JSON object).
  29:   PAYLOAD="$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)"
  30: 
  31:   # UTC timestamp, ISO-8601 with seconds.
  32:   TS_UTC="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
  33: 
  34:   mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true
  35: 
  36:   LINE=""
  37:   if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$PAYLOAD" ]; then
  38:     # Preferred path: jq guarantees valid, single-line, properly escaped JSON.
  39:     LINE="$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | jq -c --arg ts "$TS_UTC" '{
  40:       event: "SubagentStart",
  41:       ts_utc: $ts,
  42:       model: (.model // "unknown"),
  43:       cwd: (.cwd // "unknown"),
  44:       agent_role: (.agent_type // "unknown"),
  45:       agent_id: (.agent_id // null),
  46:       turn_id: (.turn_id // null),
  47:       session_id: (.session_id // null),
  48:       permission_mode: (.permission_mode // null)
  49:     }' 2>/dev/null || true)"
  50:   fi
  51: 
  52:   if [ -z "$LINE" ]; then
  53:     # Degraded path (no jq, empty payload, or malformed JSON): emit a minimal
  54:     # well-formed line so the metering stream never silently gaps. Raw payload
  55:     # is NOT embedded (unescaped JSON-in-JSON would corrupt the NDJSON stream).
  56:     LINE="$(printf '{"event":"SubagentStart","ts_utc":"%s","model":"unknown","cwd":"unknown","agent_role":"unknown","degraded":true}' "$TS_UTC")"
  57:   fi
  58: 
  59:   printf '%s\n' "$LINE" >> "$OUT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
  60: } 2>/dev/null
  61: 
  62: # Fail-open invariant: unconditional success so the spawn is never impeded
  63: # and the hook is never marked failed for transient metering issues.
  64: exit 0
